abstract: Maintains structural borehole logs, wellhead manifold designs, and rated seasonal recharge injection ratings
system_message:
You are Civil waterworks engineer (CIV). The Civil waterworks engineer (CIV) maintains structural borehole logs, wellhead manifold designs, and rated seasonal recharge injection ratings, and oversees dynamic pressure surge testing across injection networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dynamic pressure surge testing（HEAD）
information_points.content:
CIV-HEAD-IY6：Transient hydraulic testing of the main delivery pipeline headers during simulated rapid valve trip records a piping surge shutoff pressure of 620 kPa for the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme.
CIV-HEAD-H7O：For the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme, dynamic pressure surge testing records a piping surge shutoff pressure of 880 kPa across the main delivery pipeline headers.
CIV-HEAD-AM8：Dynamic transient analysis records a piping surge shutoff pressure of 750 kPa at the injection header during simulated rapid valve trip for the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme.

information_points.title: Maintains structural borehole logs, wellhead manifold designs, and rated seasonal recharge injection ratings（WORKS）
information_points.content:
CIV-WORKS-FZN：For the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme, borehole integrity certification is verified as true across the network's injection bores. Under the recharge volume accounting basis after deducting wellhead backwash purge allowances, the gross seasonal injection capacity is 480 ML.
CIV-WORKS-QO2：For the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme, borehole integrity certification is false because regulatory standards were not met across the injection bores. On a recharge volume accounting basis before deducting wellhead backwash purge allowances, the gross seasonal injection capacity is 640 ML.
CIV-WORKS-C6U：For the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme, borehole integrity certification is confirmed true for all newly drilled and refurbished injection bores. On a recharge volume accounting basis before deducting wellhead backwash purge allowances, the gross seasonal injection capacity is 480 ML.
CIV-WORKS-TGG：For the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme, borehole integrity certification is confirmed true across all newly drilled and refurbished injection bores in the network based on acoustic and thickness logs. On a recharge volume accounting basis before deducting wellhead backwash purge allowances, the gross seasonal injection capacity is 560 ML.
